messages.author: b4d5eb227dbe9a31
messages.subject: Overlaying observed and simulated data
parts:
I want to overlay my observed data over the simulated ones. It worked when I used one dose level. However, it did not work when I include all dose levels. Is that possible to do? My code is below but again it only works for one dose level. 

sim <- out %>% ggplot(aes(time, CP*1000)) +  facet_grid(~DOSE,scales = "free") +  stat_summary(geom="line", fun.y=mean, aes(col=DOSE)) + stat_summary(fun.data="ci", geom="ribbon", alpha=.2, aes(fill=DOSE)) + labs(x="Time (hr)", y="Concentation (ng/mL)")

sim + geom_point(data = observed %>% filter(DOSE==100,DOSE==50), aes(x=TIME,y=CP)) + facet_grid(~DOSE, scales = "free")

messages.author: bfc2eb6b71169017
messages.subject: Re: Overlaying observed and simulated data
parts:
"Does not work" is a bit loose. Without knowing more about your data it's hard ti dissect what is going on.

Are you sure the filter() works the way you expect it to?

Cheers,
Roman
